name: Grave 808 tresillo
desc: Baile funk grave sub in Ab minor: long 808-style sine booms locked to the tamborzão tresillo, pitch-envelope knock on each onset, dipping to the b7 and VI in the four-bar turn. Built to rattle car trunks in Rio traffic.

code.full: note("<[ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~] [ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ ~ gb1 ~] [ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~] [e1 ~ ~ e1 ~ ~ gb1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(12).pdec(.06).attack(.005).decay(.7).sustain(.15).release(.1).shape(.55).lpf(700).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ ab2 ab1 ~] [ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ ~ gb1 gb1] [ab1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ ab2 ab1 ~] [e1 ~ e1 ~ gb1 ~ ab1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(14).pdec(.05).attack(.004).decay(.6).sustain(.15).release(.08).shape(.6).lpf(850).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
